format: 
  html:

---

### Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
library(emmeans)
library(gt)
library(palmerpenguins)
library(tidyverse)
```


## Data Cleaning

First, we cleaned the data by removing any missing data points for our two variables of interest: penguin species (`species`) and penguin flipper length (`flipper_length_mm`).

```{r}
penguins_cleaned <- penguins |>
  filter_out(when_any(is.na(flipper_length_mm), is.na(species)))
```


## Analysis

Next, we fit a One-Way ANVOA model of the effect of species on penguin flipper length.

```{r}
flipper_model <- aov(flipper_length_mm ~ species, data = penguins_cleaned)

broom::tidy(flipper_model) |> 
  mutate(p.value = gtsummary::style_pvalue(p.value, digits = 3)) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "ANOVA Summary Table", subtitle = "Species on Flipper Length") |>
  cols_label(
    term = "Term",
    df = "DF",
    sumsq = "SS",
    meansq = "MS",
    statistic = "F",
    p.value = md("*p*")
  ) |>
  fmt_number() |>
  fmt_number(columns = df, decimals = 0) |>
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```


## Results

Beloe, we present the Estimated Marginal Means of penguin flipper length for each penguin species.

```{r}
emms_flipper <- emmeans(flipper_model, specs = "species")
emms_flipper
```
